name: Eastern Washington University: AKTA pure 25 FPLC (NIH S10; 2026)
brief: A primarily undergraduate institution buys a fast protein liquid chromatography system for biomolecule purification, replacing gravity-flow purification, for research and teaching.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for one FPLC system; accessories, columns, software, install and any institutional match are not itemised in the abstract.

notes: Out-of-sample: found after the cost model was frozen at commit 02d7678 and scored blind against it (results in docs/validation.md). Later model or catalog changes do not count as out-of-sample for this case. price_basis=configured, from the wording of a grant to buy a working FPLC "system" (accessories not itemised). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10GM164840-01, award_amount 176423; https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/11366771). Quote: "This proposal requests funds for acquisition of an AKTA pure 25 fast protein liquid chromatography (FPLC) system for biomolecule purification at Eastern Washington University". 1 of 1 items maps to cytiva_akta_pure_25 (exact; the 25 L/25 M variant is not stated). Caveat: S10 awards often include columns/software/service, so this is likely well above a bare unit.
